educationalModelNote: All numerical models are simplified educational models, not specifications of a real robot.

missions.title: GRASP & FRICTION
missions.concept: A grasp needs enough normal force and friction to resist object load, while excessive force can damage the object or create unsafe contact.
missions.scenario: Object mass and surface friction are imposed. Choose grip force only.
missions.goalText: Create positive anti-slip margin without simply maximizing grip force.
missions.transferText: Adapt grip force when measured friction falls.

missions.title: UNDERACTUATION & TACTILE
missions.concept: Underactuated fingers can conform with fewer actuators, but tactile feedback and compliance are needed to detect contact distribution and slip.
missions.scenario: Tactile confidence is measured. Tune tendon tension and finger compliance.
missions.goalText: Balance force distribution, conformance and tactile slip detection.
missions.transferText: Reduce force dependence and preserve a safe grasp after tactile confidence degrades.

missions.title: FORCE CONTROL
missions.concept: Contact tasks require force-motion regulation; pure pose tracking can generate excessive force when the environment blocks the target.
missions.scenario: Position error and target force are imposed. Tune stiffness and feedforward force.
missions.goalText: Match desired contact force without relying on extreme stiffness.
missions.transferText: Retune force response after the environment moves relative to the expected pose.

missions.title: HANDOVER & HRI
missions.concept: A safe handover combines grasp stability, human intent evidence and bounded release logic; neither appearance nor pull force alone is enough.
missions.scenario: Human pull and intent confidence are sensed evidence. You control robot grip and release state.
missions.goalText: Release only when physical and intent evidence both support takeover.
missions.transferText: Do not release during ambiguous intent; hold and wait for stronger evidence.

missions.title: SERVICEABILITY & INDUSTRIAL DESIGN
missions.concept: Exterior design participates in motion clearance, sensing, cooling, impact protection and service access; a cosmetic change can alter system performance.
missions.scenario: A sealing requirement is imposed later. Tune panel thickness, vent area and service access.
missions.goalText: Preserve motion, cooling and serviceability simultaneously.
missions.transferText: Recover cooling/service margin after the sealing requirement is added.

missions.title: MANIPULATION GATE
missions.concept: Demonstrate grasp stability, compliant contact, handover logic and interface awareness.
missions.scenario: Object/friction/intent conditions change between cases. You control grip and release state.
missions.goalText: Complete the three manipulation gate cases.

gateCases.name: GRASP
gateCases.text: Hold the imposed 3 kg object with >8 N margin and grip <80 N.

gateCases.name: COMPLIANT CONTACT
gateCases.text: On a high-friction object, retain >35 N capacity while keeping grip below 55 N.

gateCases.name: HANDOVER
gateCases.text: Human intent is strong; release only with moderate grip.
